title: MoreDimensions
description: Allow players to build portals to another world (aether, etc)
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bdd5db7366193802f344f4cb56b76798255c9cb_0.webp)

MoreDimensions - Advanced Custom Portals

Seamlessly connect your worlds with beautifully animated, fully customizable portals!
MoreDimensions is the ultimate solution for server owners who want to create custom dimension portals without the hassle.

- ✅ Better performance
- ✅ No unwanted terrain generation
- ✅ Maximum flexibility

✨ Features

Fully Customizable Portal Materials
Create portals in virtually any vanilla shape:

- Choose any frame block
- Choose any inside block
- Choose any ignition item

The plugin automatically updates their block states to connect perfectly to the frame.

✨ Custom Particle Colors
Bring your portals to life with beautiful particle effects.

Available Colors:
- RED
- GREEN
- BLUE
- YELLOW
- PURPLE
- AQUA
- ORANGE
- WHITE
- BLACK

Safe Teleportation System
Inspired by vanilla Nether portal behavior.

The plugin:
- Finds safe ground automatically
- Prevents teleporting into lava
- Prevents spawning inside walls
- Generates a safe platform if needed


#⚙️ Configuration Example


```
portals:
  mining_portal:
    destination_world: "mining_world"
    frame_block: "COBBLED_DEEPSLATE"
    inside_block: "LIGHT_BLUE_STAINED_GLASS_PANE"
    igniter_item: "DIAMOND_PICKAXE"
    player_ignition: true
    particle_color: "AQUA"
```
